source.original: NCBI GEO GSE133344, Norman et al. Science 2019

objective: On distinct previously unseen two-gene perturbation identities within the same published K562 biological system, test whether persistent directly editable native causal-effect weights compose better than strong same-information fully fitted conventional predictors, while retaining prior single-gene effects.
north_star: tokenless causal weight programming with cumulative retention, not a transformer or next-token foundation
design_stage: metadata-only split executable; training model, training pipeline and final confirmatory prereg NOT YET IMPLEMENTED

cohort.parser: guide_identity.split('__',1)[0].split('_'); exactly two gene/control tokens; original author RHOXF2 -> RHOXF2B correction
cohort.canonical_pair: two distinct non-control genes sorted lexicographically; only when each parent has observed single-gene cohort
cohort.split_source: sha256(b'WSP191-NORMAN-GSE133344-PAIR-SPLIT-v1' + b'\x00' + geneA + b'\x00' + geneB); first 8 bytes big-endian modulo 100
cohort.unit_of_independence: whole canonical gene-pair identity; never individual cell
cohort.holdout_gate: If minimum split sizes or parent singles not present, STOP without rebalancing, choosing alternative salt or scoring any expression outcome.
cohort.known_public_data_limitation: Public cohort and prior published pair results are not virgin blinded scientific holdout.
cohort.cold_single_retention: Independent single-cell/guide/batch holdout required; if no independent retained single source, mark behavior retention UNVERIFIED.

planned_comparison.candidate: Evidence-gated local direct-weight single-gene effect modules and shared pair-composition operator, with bounded localized updates; train only on FIT and select using VALID.
controls: fully fitted same-FIT-data additive parent-effect estimator
regularized pair-interaction low-rank/bilinear learner fully trained on same FIT pairs
converged independent MLP treatment-effect predictor with matched information and training budget
original physical/study-relevant strong predictor if reproducible without hidden test or pretrained label access
negative_controls: shuffled FIT pair identities, same training budget
planned_comparison.preprocessing: Fit gene normalization, controls, gene vocabulary/feature selection and hyperparameters on FIT; select control and model using VALID only; hold DEV pair cells and effects sealed.
metrics: equal-pair-weighted normalized RMSE on held pair treatment-effect vectors
paired pair-level bootstrap confidence interval of relative improvement
old single-gene cold-retention error after pair learning
source bytes and wall/cpu/rss/serialized model bytes
planned_comparison.development_rule: Candidate at least 5% lower held mean pair-normalized RMSE than strongest validation-selected fully converged matched control and paired bootstrap 95% lower CI on relative gain > 0, without >3% relative old-single retained error increase (when independent retention cohort exists).
planned_comparison.failure_rule: Insufficient verified source controls, no independent holdout batches, missing matched baseline convergence, data leakage, unqualified compute, negative gate, or unsupported transfer: stop/no-go; preserve actual result and do not retune held DEV.
planned_comparison.qualifier_budget: One pre-frozen public DEV scoring pass after engineering qualification; at most two predeclared FIT-only exploratory qualification passes and no post-DEV hyperparameter tuning.
planned_comparison.science_boundaries: Development on known K562 pair combinations is not new-world transfer, causal graph identifiability, action-consequence policy learning, native Yggdrasil training, or SCIENTIFIC_PASS.

before_experiment_remaining: verify all four authentic GEO filtered bytes against third-party manifest and independently recorded SHA256
validate identity-to-barcode mapping and author-defined control/single/pair semantics against actual metadata
examine contamination, batch and biological replicate counts WITHOUT expression outcomes, prove source license
resolve whether per-pair independent batches and single retention test are feasible
freeze exact learner capacity/ranks, conventional baseline convergence criteria, seeds and evaluation environment BEFORE inspecting results
complete Windows and Linux mandatory final candidate regression in an authorized route
obtain separate project owner acceptance authority for native Yggdrasil integration if justified
